gates: cargo test (workspace, includes the capability law suites)

load_network.description: Register an authored network document (the planner's JSON document, produced or derived by the network capability) under its content hash; idempotent.

load_population_layer.description: Register a GeoJSON population layer under its content hash. Bulk-bytes op 0; pop_field optional (common candidates tried).

network_stats.description: The network's numbers on one service date: trips, spans, revenue hours, per-route and per-stop activity, headways.

service_type_detail.description: One service type expanded on its representative day: routes, stops, schedules, totals.

service_types_overview.description: Every service type's numbers, each on its representative day — the design axis, no calendar dates in sight.

type_coverage.description: Population coverage per service type against a hash-addressed layer: what share of the population each type serves, and serves frequently.

purpose: Planner analysis over an authored network document: network/route/stop stats, per-service-type overview and detail, population coverage. The first capability extracted from the monolith — the domain code lives in the shared transit-analysis library. Assemble for planners; riders never download it. Documents are hash-addressed (load once, query by hash — never per-op document serialization).
